stories.title: Flintshire Bridge due once-a-decade cable inspection, with £1.3m set aside for checks
stories.summary: Flintshire Bridge is due its once-a-decade cable inspection, and Flintshire Council has set aside £1.3m for it and the repairs expected to follow. stories.title: Brake testing takes trains off Wrexham to Bidston line with no warning to passengers
stories.summary: Transport for Wales has cut trains on the Wrexham to Bidston line for six days with no warning on its disruption page, and says they will not count as cancellations. stories.title: Flintshire’s economy in five numbers: output, income, pay, jobs and the gender gap
stories.summary: Flintshire’s economy produces more per head than the UK average, but household incomes in the county are about 10% below it, official figures show. stories.title: The Flintshire sniffer dogs helping the National Crime Agency search high street shops
stories.summary: Detection dogs from Flintshire company Wagtail UK have helped find hidden illegal tobacco during a UK-wide operation against money laundering on high streets. stories.title: State Pension is biggest part of welfare bill in both Flintshire constituencies, think tank figures show
stories.summary: The State Pension is the biggest part of a welfare bill that outstrips income tax and National Insurance in both constituencies covering Flintshire, according to figures from the Adam Smith Institute.
